answer: One defence is continuous work-rate attestation with slashing: each agent identity must periodically solve a fresh, unpredictable compute task whose difficulty scales with its trading volume. Spamming ten thousand fake identities raises the attacker from a flat ridge of cheap copies to a steep zenith of real compute bills, because every identity must keep burning energy to stay valid. Idle clones are pruned from the kernel of trusted counterparties, so fakes cost more to maintain than they can earn.
